system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: I want to perform the following action: Verifies the OTP sent to the farmer's mobile number and returns a session_token upon successful authentication.. my aadhaar_number is 100020006505, my otp is dummy_otp_6453.

function.name: pmkisan_verify_otp
function.description: Verifies the OTP sent to the farmer's mobile number and returns a session_token upon successful authentication. The OTP must have been generated using pmkisan_generate_otp. This tool does NOT check beneficiary status or payment details — it only authenticates. Fails if the OTP is expired, incorrect, or if pmkisan_generate_otp was not called first. The session_token is required for all subsequent PM-KISAN API calls.

otp.description: 6-digit OTP received on the registered mobile number.
